title: Open Workout Schema v0: log
description: A person's whole workout log as one file: what an export holds and an import can read. Workouts and routines are OWS documents. A server may add more of the person's record beside them (a profile, say), under keys this schema doesn't name; readers ignore keys they don't know. Draft; may change until v1.

workouts.description: Every workout in the log, newest first.

deleted_workouts.description: Workouts the person deleted, or that a merge with another app's record of the same session hid (merged_into), newest first. A server that keeps them until the account is deleted includes them, so the file holds the whole record.

merged_into.description: The workout this one was merged into.
